items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Butterbeans and Susie, (inaudible) Ma Rainey, Bessie Smith, all those type of people.

ctx.x: Stanley, my inspiration to become a drummer was a fellow who inspired me to no end, the utmost in sensational drumming, was a drummer by the name of Booker Washington at the Palace Theater. He was in the pit, only had about seven, eight pieces, but my aunt used to take me to the Palace Theater once a week so I could see this drummer. Boy, that man, wow, who played the Palace Theater -- Butterbeans and Susie, (inaudible) Ma Rainey, Bessie Smith, all those type of people.
Well, how was the theater built? What did it look like?
